description: Rename a project, replace the website domains and brand names it is monitored for, or both. A rename alone removes nothing. brandProfile replaces both lists entirely: pass every domain and name the project should keep. A domain or brand name left out is removed, and later checks no longer match on it; results already recorded are not re-matched or deleted. Show the user the full new lists before calling. Safe to retry.

brandProfile.description: Replaces the website domains and brand names the project is monitored for.
